arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m. CP boat 95 W / shaft 152 W (may be 10-25 pct off). Start hot as expected (140 W boat, 212 W shaft). Aim: settle near CP, keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above ~0.3 until last 1.5 km, then spend it all. Watch for: drag (weed on rudder: push_local drops while pod power steady), instrument drift, wrong CP, current changes.

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts vs fitted current: drag (rudder weed?) or local current
shaft power well under critical power for a minute
1600 m to go: plan the finish

text: no cue: hot start is expected to settle on its own; set watches for drag, low pod reserve, under-effort and the finish zone.

arguments.message: shaft power above what the pod reserve can hold to the finish

arguments.text: Min 4 (700 m, leg 1 out, headwind/current push -0.15): settled at shaft 159-164 W vs sustainable 156 W (CP 152), pod reserve 63 pct, boat reserve 51 pct (boat model drains faster: boat/shaft efficiency 0.66 vs 0.625 at test, so trust pod). Slightly hot but small; no cue yet. If still above ~160 W shaft at next check, cue a gentle ease (no ground pace target: out-and-back with current).

text: no cue: effort only slightly above sustainable after the start; watching pod reserve trend before asking for an ease.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Long smooth strokes, save it for later.

Min 6.6 (1170 m, leg 2 back, tailwind +0.15): shaft 164-166 W vs sustainable 156, pod reserve 50 pct and falling ~5 pct/min. Cued a gentle ease (no pace target). Check next wake-up: want shaft ~155-158 W and pod drain under ~1.5 pct/min. If shaft drops below ~148, cue hold/push slightly.

text: Cued a gentle ease: shaft power 10 W over critical power was draining the pod reserve about 5 pct per minute with 6.8 km left.

arguments.message: boat speed at same rate fell 3 pct vs early race: fatigue or drag (weed)
boat power below test critical power for 90 s

arguments.text: Min 9.6 POD DRIFT: after my ease cue shaft fell to ~158 W, then from ~13 min-mark (t=775 s) shaft_power ramped smoothly 158 -> 206 W in 110 s with speed_water (3.04) and rate (61) unchanged; paddler says 5/10, plenty. So the pod reads high (strain zero drift), not weed. Ignore shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac, push_local_mps, sustainable_shaft. Removed pod watches; added fade and low boat power watches. True shaft before drift ~158 W, pod reserve was ~45 pct.

Min 9.6 CP DOUBT: boat reserve reads 8 pct after 10 min at boat 106-111 W vs CP 95, yet no fade (+0.7 pct) and paddler 5/10. Boat/shaft ratio 0.70 vs 0.625 at test: boat CP 95 likely too low (maybe ~105). Plan: keep paddler steady (~108-110 W boat, no cue); if cp_implied_w appears or no fade by ~min 15 with reserve at 0, set_critical_power cp_w ~105-108 so finish timing is right.

text: no cue: pod power is drifting high (smooth ramp, speed and rate unchanged, paddler 5/10), so I dropped pod-based watches and will judge effort from boat speed; boat critical power looks too low, revisit at min 15.
no cue: pod_low alert comes from the drifting pod (watch already removed); boat speed and rate steady, no fade.

arguments.text: Min 12.9 (2330 m, leg 3): both reserves read 0 (pod is drifted, boat CP too low) but speed at same rate is +1.9 pct vs early race at boat 110-115 W, rate 61. Do NOT ease because reserve reads 0; judge by fade (watch fade_min_5min < -3) and paddler. Best guess true boat CP ~105-110 W. Around min 19 check cp_implied_w / steady_power_10min_w via race_history and set_critical_power then. Finish plan: hold steady, start finish push about 1200-1500 m out if no fade.

text: no cue: steady at boat 110 W with no fade; the zero reserve readings come from a drifted pod and a too-low boat critical power.

arguments.message: turned onto a south-going leg: into the new south wind

arguments.text: Min 13.4 RADIO: wind filling from the south 8-12 kn. North legs (odd: 1,3,5,7) now tailwind, south legs (2,4,6,8) headwind. push_along fit lags: on this north leg speed_water/power_w/fade read too high (129 W, +5.7 pct is wind, not paddler); on the next south leg they will read too low, so boat_low_effort and fade watches may false-fire until the fit catches up after a turn or two. Plan: at each south-leg turn (headwind_leg watch) cue a modest push into the wind; on north legs let it fade / hold.

text: no cue: south wind now helps this north leg (speed jump is wind, not the paddler); set a watch to cue a modest push at the turn into the headwind.

arguments.text: Into the wind after this turn. Lift effort a little.

text: Cued a modest push for the headwind leg starting at this turn: time spent into the wind is where extra effort buys the most.
no cue: push into the wind already cued just before this turn.

arguments.text: Min 18 (3250 m, leg 4 south, headwind): fade alert -4.7 pct is the wind-fit lag (GPS south 2.96-3.0 vs 3.2 before wind; north rose 2.87 -> 3.0), paddler 6/10 plenty. Pushed into wind at min 16.5. To rule out weed later: on leg 5 north GPS speed should be back near 3.0+; if both directions slow, suspect weed and cue clear_rudder.

text: no cue: fade reading is the headwind not yet in the current fit; paddler 6/10 with plenty left.
no cue: steady through the headwind leg at about 3.0 m/s over the ground; boat power readings still distorted by the wind fit, paddler reported plenty at min 18.

arguments.text: Min 24 (4330 m, leg 5 north): GPS 3.0 north, same as leg 3 with wind, so no weed. Reserve numbers useless (0). FINISH PLAN: leg 6 south (3000-2000 m to go, headwind): cue push at the turn. Leg 7 north (2000-1000 to go): hold, ask paddler at ~1600 to go (finish_zone watch). Leg 8 south into headwind: cue finish at ~900-1000 m to go if paddler under 8/10, else ~600 m.

text: no cue: steady on the tailwind leg, no sign of drag; plan is to push into the wind on leg 6 and finish on the last headwind leg.

arguments.text: Good call. Build it steadily, strongest into the wind.

Min 25.1 (4530 m, 3470 to go): paddler said feeling great, going. GPS speed flat 2.95-3.05 whole race, no fade, cp_implied absent. Consistent story: test CP too low (boat and pod), paddler has reserve. Cued reassure (back their move, no extra push). Next: if GPS speed fades (north under 2.95 or south under 2.85) or paddler over 8/10 before 1500 to go, cue hold/ease; else follow finish plan.

text: Reassured the paddler: no fade all race and the test critical power looks too low, so their own move at 3.5 km is backed without adding a further push.

arguments.text: Yes, likely weed. One back-stroke to clear the rudder.

Min 27.3 (4920 m): paddler said boat heavy, something on rudder. Same north leg: GPS 3.05 -> 2.94, fade +2.7 -> -1.5, push_local -0.07 -> -0.165 with pod (offset) steady: drag. Cued clear_rudder. Check after: GPS on south legs should be ~3.0 and north ~3.0-3.05, push_local back near -0.07 to -0.1. If still slow, cue clear_rudder again.

arguments.message: push_local low (pod offset steady ~ -0.07 to -0.12 normally): drag still on, maybe weed again

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reports a heavy boat and speed fell on the same leg with effort steady, the signature of weed on the rudder; watch set in case it persists.

arguments.message: drag looks gone after clear_rudder: time to push into the wind on leg 6

text: no cue: just turned and just cleared the rudder; watches will wake me when the drag is gone (then push into the wind) or if it persists (clear again).

arguments.text: Still dragging. Clear the rudder again, one firm back-stroke.

Min 29.1 (5230 m, leg 6 south): drag persists after first clear (GPS 2.84 vs ~2.98 normal on south legs, push_local -0.19 to -0.22, pod steady 216 so not fatigue). Cued clear_rudder a second time. clear_ok watch will fire when push_local > -0.13 for 20 s: then cue push into the wind.

text: Cued clear_rudder again: speed still well below normal for this leg with steady effort, so the weed is still on.
no cue: the fade is the rudder drag, second clear_rudder cue just given; waiting for it to act.
no cue: low boat power is the rudder drag already being cleared; removed the duplicate fade and low-power watches (drag2 and clear_ok cover it).

arguments.text: Weed still on. Hard back-stroke now, clear the rudder.

Min 32.4 (5800 m, 2200 to go): south-leg GPS stuck 2.82-2.87 for 5 min after two clear cues, push_local -0.15; paddler 10/10, boat feels heavy, like something dragging. Cued clear_rudder a third time. Next: on leg 7 north expect GPS ~3.0 if clear. If still slow, clear again. If clear but paddler still 9-10/10, cue hold (not push) until ~700 m, then finish.

text: Cued clear_rudder a third time: paddler at 10/10 reports dragging and speed is still well down at steady effort.

arguments.text: Rudder is clear, boat is free. Settle and keep it smooth.

Min 33.6 (5980 m, 2020 to go): clear_ok fired, push_local back to -0.06 after third clear_rudder. Cued reassure (rudder clear). Paddler was 10/10 at min 32.4 while dragging. At finish_zone (1600 to go, leg 7 north) ask paddler: if 8 or less, cue finish at the last turn (1000 to go, into headwind); if 9-10, hold and cue finish at ~500 m.

text: Told the paddler the rudder is clear (reassure): drag gone after the third back-stroke; finish timing decided at 1600 m to go from how they feel.

arguments.message: about 550 m to go: cue the finish sprint

arguments.text: Min 36.1 (6400 m, 1600 to go, leg 7 north): paddler 9/10 says plenty, but north GPS 2.81 vs 3.0 earlier and pod reading fell ~20 W after the weed fight: likely tired. Plan: no cue on this tailwind leg; at the last turn (headwind_leg watch, 1000 to go) cue push into the wind; at ~550 to go (finish_500 watch) cue finish.

text: no cue: paddler 9/10 and slower after the weed; graded finish planned, push into the wind at the last turn and sprint from about 550 m.

arguments.text: Hold it here. Go harder after the last turn, into wind.

text: Cued hold: paddler wants to go now but speed shows fatigue after the weed; saving the extra effort for the last headwind leg where it buys the most.

arguments.text: Last leg, into the wind. Go harder now, build to the line.

text: Cued push at the last turn: final 1000 m into the headwind is where extra effort pays most; full sprint cue at about 550 m to go.

arguments.text: 500 to go. Sprint now, empty everything to the line!

text: Cued the final sprint at 555 m to go, into the headwind.
no cue: 75 m to go, inside the last 100 m where cues are not allowed.
